title: Fold Lamp: Light Right on the Page
sourceTitle: Fold Lamp: a fictional product demo

scenes.title: First, a crowded desk
scenes.narration: There’s barely any room left to read. The lamp hogs a corner, leaving the page dim. Bring the light closer and the desk fills up.
scenes.sourceQuote: There’s barely any room left to read. The lamp hogs a corner, leaving the page dim. Bring the light closer and the desk fills up.

props.headline: The light misses the book
props.detail: Lamp in the corner · shadow on the page

scenes.title: A desk lamp that folds
scenes.narration: Fold Lamp tucks its arm into a slim base. Open it, and the panel swings forward. Closed, it sits at the edge, off your page.
scenes.sourceQuote: Fold Lamp tucks its arm into a slim base. Open it, and the panel swings forward. Closed, it sits at the edge, off your page.

props.headline: Open to light, fold to store
props.detail: Slim base · swivel arm · warm panel

scenes.title: Put the light where you need it
scenes.narration: Slide the base up beside your book. Lift the arm and turn the orange knob. Warm light falls on your page and notebook. If you shift in your seat, nudge the panel.
scenes.sourceQuote: Slide the base up beside your book. Lift the arm and turn the orange knob. Warm light falls on your page and notebook. If you shift in your seat, nudge the panel.

props.headline: Slide, lift, turn
props.detail: Light lands where you read and write

scenes.title: After reading, a calm desk
scenes.narration: When you’re done, fold the panel back. There’s room for your mug again. Next time, book, pen and light all fit again.
scenes.sourceQuote: When you’re done, fold the panel back. There’s room for your mug again. Next time, book, pen and light all fit again.

props.headline: Room for what you’re doing
props.detail: Book · pen · mug, each in its place
